LINEHOUND V2 FULL PRODUCT REFRESH V1 KEPT AS ROLLBACK
SAME HOUND. SHARPER TEETH.
A refresh, not a repaint. The identity holds — warm neutral near-black, angled HUD geometry, condensed italic display, mono figures, hot red reserved for a genuinely better price. What changes is structure: Gameday becomes a carousel of team-colour environments, the seam gets a job, and price and action become one welded object.
NEW IN V2
Amber for caution, pending and unavailable
SIGNATURE MOTION
420ms matchup swap along the seam angle
RESERVED STILL
Hot red = a genuinely better price. Nothing else.
01 DESIGN TOKENS
Three signal colours, each with exactly one job, on a warm neutral ground. Amber is the only addition in V2 — it takes the caution and unavailability work that red was wrongly absorbing.
GROUND AND SURFACE
HEXTOKENJOB
#0A0A0B --v-ground Page ground. Warm neutral near-black. — 2% warm, never brown
#121214 --v-s1 Standard HUD panel base
#17171A --v-s2 Raised panel, scorebug column
#1D1D21 --v-s3 Top surface — active slate tile, price bug
rgba(255,255,255,.045) --v-fill Panel gradient start, to .012
rgba(255,255,255,.07) --v-edge Standard 1px inset ring
rgba(255,255,255,.028) --v-scan Scanline, repeating 0deg 1px on 3px
rgba(255,255,255,.024) --v-carbon Carbon weave, 112deg 2px on 5px
HOT RED · A GENUINELY BETTER PRICE
Reserved, unchanged from V1. Hot red marks a price that genuinely beats consensus, or the action that takes you to one. It never marks a category, a risk, or a state. One red object per region.
HEXTOKENJOB
#FF3D57 --v-money Price-advantage surfaces, welded CHECK tab, primary action
#FF7A45 --v-money-2 Gradient end on every money surface
#FF6274 --v-money-lit Best-price dot, active nav glyph, verdict text
#FF9AA6 --v-money-soft Secondary money figures
#FFB3BD --v-money-label Eyebrows and book names inside money panels
#22060A --v-money-ink Type on hot-red fills
ICE CYAN · ANALYTICAL, LIVE, CHANGED
Reserved. Cyan is measurement and movement: timestamps, eyebrows, the CHEAPER marker on book-versus-book, movement charts, the expand control. It never carries price advantage and it never signals a warning.
HEXTOKENJOB
#00E0FF --v-live Primary cyan. Eyebrows, timestamps, CHEAPER highlight, chart stroke
#0090C8 --v-live-2 Gradient end on cyan fills
#A8F4FF --v-live-lit Type on cyan fills, lit labels
#9FE9F5 --v-live-label HUD eyebrow on dark seams
#03222B --v-live-ink Type on cyan fills
AMBER · CAUTION, PENDING, UNAVAILABLE
New in V2. Amber is the third state red used to swallow. Stale quotes, projected-not-confirmed lineups, awaiting settlement, and NOT YET AVAILABLE all read amber. It means know this, not danger — red stays for risk to the bet itself, and amber must never be mistaken for a price advantage.

FORBIDDEN No brown, sepia or muddy warm neutral. No rainbow status system — three signal colours only, each with one job. No green: a settled win is cyan, because cyan already means measured fact. No colour outside these tokens without amending this page.

03 SPACING, GRID AND GEOMETRY
The seam angle is the one constant across every screen and both viewports.
SPACING SCALE
2 / 4px List row gap, tight figure stacks
6 / 8px Chip internals, glyph to label
10 / 12px Inline gaps, marker to text, control row gap
14 / 18px Panel-to-panel rhythm, component kit gutters
22 / 26px Panel padding — 22px vertical, 26px horizontal
32px Top-bar horizontal padding
40px Desktop content gutter — every section aligns to it
48px Document gutter on this page
64px Section top padding
14 / 16 / 18px Mobile gutters: cards, prose, rail
GRID AND WIDTHS
Desktop min-width 1360px for this document; product screens 900px
Icon rail 76px fixed; active shape breaks 11px past the edge
Content column margin-left 76px, gutter 40px
Carousel band clamp(560px,64vh,720px) tall, full bleed
Slate strip Below the band, 268 × 172 tiles, 16px gap
Book-vs-book table book A 1fr · CHEAPER 148px · book B 1fr
Evidence rack repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)), gap 18px
Copy measure max-width 700–860px prose, 420px side columns
Mobile frame 390 × 844, radius 42px — the only true radius
SEAM ANGLE · THE ONE CONSTANT
skewX(-9deg) 56% / 40%
Left half polygon(0 0, 56% 0, 40% 100%, 0 100%)
Right half polygon(56% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 40% 100%)
Seam rule 3px at left:50%, transform skewX(-9deg)
Sweep track 24px wide, margin-left -12px, same skew, clipped
Both halves inset -30 to -40px so parallax never shows an edge
Mobile seam polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 42%,0 50%) and complement
Team rule 92–112 × 6px, transform skewX(-18deg)
CHAMFER GEOMETRY
R6
R11
R16
R20
MIRROR
Standard chamfer cuts top-left and bottom-right. The mirrored variant cuts top-right and bottom-left, and exists so a welded pair reads as one object — the price body and its CHECK tab meet on a straight edge.
R = 4 / 5 Markers, small chips
R = 6 / 8 Status chips, nav shape, meter segments
R = 11 / 12 Buttons, fields, controls, small tiles
R = 14 / 16 Price bug, HUD panels, mobile cards
R = 18 / 20 Hero price bug, slate tile, feature panel
radius 42px Mobile device frame only

03 VERDICT · NO DEMONSTRATED EDGE the primary state
NO DEMONSTRATED EDGE
Interesting matchup, but no demonstrated betting edge.
All fifteen games return verdict: no_play with an empty findings array. This is not the empty state — it is the state, every day. So it gets real typography, a neutral badge and a straight sentence.
SAYSNo demonstrated edge NEVER SAYSPass, avoid, fade, skip, or stay away COLOURNeutral white-on-ghost. Not red, not amber — no edge is not a warning. WEIGHTFull-size type. A quiet fact still deserves a confident setting.

YOUR PRICE BEATS CONSENSUS +8c CONSENSUS BEATS YOUR PRICE -6c PRICE MATCHES CONSENSUS 0c
The delta never ships as a bare number. your_price_beats_consensus is false about eighty percent of the time, so the label carries the direction and the money colour appears only when it is genuinely true.

implied_probabilityShips as a fraction in 0–1. Rendered as 0.532, never as 53.2% — a percent implies a precision the field does not claim. spread_centsCents of disagreement between books. It is not a point spread and must never be typeset like one. CONSENSUS FLOORNeeds 6 books. 0.3% of measured instants fall below it, and then consensus is null.
07 GAP LEDGER ROW 11 named gaps
! starter_stat_lines Probable names ship; FIP, ERA and WHIP are not exposed. NOT AVAILABLE
! lineups No lineup feed contracted. NOT AVAILABLE
! weather Requires a venue-resolved source we do not have. NOT AVAILABLE
Amber, equal weight, with the reason string rendered rather than summarised. A gap is a finding about our coverage, not an error in the page.
08 SETTLEMENT STATUS five states, exact wording
won Won
lost Lost
push Game ended tied
void-unmatchable Can’t match this bet to a game
null · null · null Not settled yet
Unsettled reads Not settled yet and nothing more — there is no reason field, so there is no explanation to give and we do not invent one.
09 RELEVANCE TIER UNKNOWN sits outside the order
LOW
MEDIUM
HIGH
?
UNKNOWN
UNKNOWN means cannot characterize. It is separated by a dashed break and set in amber, never rendered as the shortest bar — sorting it below LOW would assert something the field explicitly declines to say.
10 EVIDENCE STATUS three renderings
observed Observation NO BADGE
unproven Observation NO BADGE
tested_null Tested — did not hold up TESTED
blocked Not available with our data NO BADGE
Max reachable tier is 1, so Observation is what ships. Only tested_null earns a badge — being tested and failing is more informative than never having been tested, and the badge says so.
NO LIMITED / MODERATE / STRONG LADDER — WRONG WORD SET, AND UNREACHABLE
11 SAMPLE STAMP constructor refuses a bare number
9 of 11 books repriced this side n = 11 books
0.532 de-vigged implied probability n = 11 books
9c spread between books n = 11 books
Every quantitative claim ships with sample_n and sample_unit or the constructor refuses to build it. That refusal is a product feature, so the sample sits beside the number rather than in a footnote.

MOTION SPEC V2-01 · GAMEDAY DESKTOP
EYE FIRST The verdict headline. There is no money moment tonight, so nothing is hot red — the eye goes to the sentence, then the club names.
ANIMATES Verdict panel grise. Band blooms from the away edge. Club names swap 60ms apart. Board bugs arrive at 340ms. Seam sweeps on an 11s loop.
TRIGGER Entrance on load. Swap on prev/next, a slate tile, or arrow keys. No digit pulse — Gameday has no price-change field to react to.
TIMING matchup-swap 420ms wiping along the seam angle · price-arrival 340ms rising 16px · tile-focus 180ms · rail-select 240ms
HOVER / TAP Slate tile lifts 4px. Board bug and its welded tab highlight as one object. Board-count chip tooltips the exact book count. Focus rings 2px cyan.
SCROLL Band halves parallax at .06; the verdict sentence and the board bugs never move while being read.
MOBILE Seam goes horizontal, club names stack and drop to the abbreviation at the narrowest widths, slate becomes a snapping rail. Parallax and seam sweep drop.
05b THE THREE VERDICT STATES
Three states with confident posture. no_play stays calm and self-assured — it is the most frequent read, not the product’s personality. flagged is a genuine event and is built to feel like one. market_unavailable is honest absence in amber, never breakage.
MEASURED FREQUENCY · n = 129 FORWARD-LEDGER ENTRIES

NO_PLAY · THE DEFAULT · BEST COMPOSITION IN THE PRODUCT MARKET_UNAVAILABLE · HONEST ABSENCE · NEVER BREAKAGE FLAGGED · THE RARE EXCEPTION · SHOULD FEEL SPECIAL
Across the research programme to date, twenty-seven pre-registered hypotheses have produced zero survivors. A no-play result is the honesty engine working — the product declining to manufacture a reason to act. So the 93% state gets the strongest composition we have, and the 2% state earns its rarity rather than being the only screen that looks designed.

MOTION SPEC V2-01a · b · c · THE VERDICT FAMILY
EYE FIRST no_play: the two-line verdict sentence. flagged: the -110 and its bloom. market_unavailable: the plain statement, then the payload.
ANIMATES no_play rises with no bloom and no pulse — confidence is stillness. flagged blooms from the left in 420ms and its price pulses. market_unavailable rises only.
TRIGGER On load per state. The flagged bloom fires once and never loops — a repeating celebration would cheapen a 2% event.
TIMING grise .72s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.3,1) · flagged bloom 420ms · digit pulse 220ms, flagged only · no chart anywhere, no endpoint exists
HOVER / TAP Best-price rows hover cyan and hand off to Bet Check pre-filled. All three states keep the same three onward paths.
SCROLL None parallax. A verdict is read, not flown through.
MOBILE 390px: verdict headline drops to 40px, the check panel and market panel stack, and the flagged bloom halves in radius.

MOTION SPEC V2-02 · ODDS BOARD
EYE FIRST The slate-summary headline, then the tied best-price panels. Hot red appears only on prices that are genuinely best on their board.
ANIMATES Header grise; variant panels grise at 80/140/200ms; best-price panels arrive at 340ms; board rows stagger 40ms.

STRAIGHT ANSWERS
What happens after three checks?
They’re gone — three in total, not three a day. The board stays open; Bet Check needs Founding Access.
Do you guarantee winners?
No. Anyone who does is selling you something. We show what argues against a bet and where the price sits.
What data is this?
Captured moneyline prices from the books we track, plus team records and probable starter names. Capture is hourly and every board shows its capture time.
How do I cancel?
From your account, yourself. It schedules at the end of the current period and you keep access until then.
Do I get a confirmation email?
We don’t promise one. Your activation code appears once on screen after checkout — copy it there.
What if I lose my code?
Contact support and we’ll reissue. Codes last fourteen days.
THREE CHECKS. THEN DECIDE.
Run them on bets you actually care about. If it doesn’t change how you look at your card, don’t pay us.

11 REPRESENTATIVE VALUES binding table
Read this before implementing any screen above. It is the contract between the artboards and the payload.
REPRESENTATIVE VALUES EVERY NUMBER BINDS TO A FIELD.
Every figure and every clock time in these artboards is representative content, bound at implementation to the field or calculation named below. None ships as a literal. The governing rule: a number appears only if an implementer can trace it to a real field, or to a deterministic client-side calculation over fields they actually receive on that screen.
SLATE AND VERDICT · GAMEDAY
SHOWN IN ARTBOARDBINDS TONOTE
15 games games_count Slate summary, or len(games) on the slate endpoint. Date-dependent — never a literal 15.
13 boards received count(has_board == true) Client-side count over the games this screen received.
2 no board count(has_board == false) Same pass. Renders the market_unavailable state per game.
11 deepest board max(board_summary.books) Per-game field. There is no slate-wide book count on this feed.
5 thinnest board min(board_summary.books) Same. Observed floor across measurement is 5.
27 programme static constant Cumulative pre-registered hypotheses, kept in sync with docs/RESUME.md and docs/OVERNIGHT_RUN.md. Never presented as tonight’s count.
93.0 / 4.7 / 2.3% forward ledger, n = 129 Verdict distribution. Recompute as the ledger grows; never hardcode.
no_play verdict Enum. Renders the constant string “Interesting matchup, but no demonstrated betting edge.”

THE APPEND RULE
Advanced never replaces Quick View. On mobile it expands inline directly beneath it; on desktop it appends below. The chevron rotates 180° and the block grows downward in 380ms — so the thing you were reading stays exactly where it was.
STAYSMatchup identity, verdict, price block, teams table. APPENDSFive real sections, eleven gaps, book-versus-book. NEVER APPEARSWeather, bullpen, starter stat lines, movement chart. GAP ROWSTap for the reason string. Not links — there is nowhere to go. MOTIONadvanced-expand 380ms, chevron 240ms. No parallax on a reading surface.
20 THE FEATURED BET the primitive
One wager gets a poster, not a table row. The standing is the loudest thing on it, because the read is the card’s job — and every segment traces to something the user could check themselves. Tier A is the truthful current state; Tier B is the flagship it becomes once the research earns it.
POSTURE
Linehound rates the quality of a bet, shows the case for and against, and evaluates the price. The honesty stays exactly as it was — no-play is one of three states, not the personality. The posture is confident analysis, and the confidence comes from every element being checkable. What the system measures today is market state: where a price sits against the de-vigged consensus, how deep the board is, and what the evidence says. Merit judgements arrive with Tier B, once they are earned.

Not a prohibition — a claim we have not earned yet. The research programme exists to earn it: validated ratings, calibrated probabilities where scientifically defensible, ranked boards and public performance tracking. ANATOMY · EVERY PART LABELLED A OR B
TIERPARTSTATE-DRIVENNOTE
A Spine label yes Rotated card type down the left edge. Makes a stack scannable.
A Team environment no Abbreviation mark bleeding off the right edge at 13% opacity, plus a team-colour bloom. Never a photo.
A Spec strip yes MARKET | LINE | SIDE with hairline dividers. Side is the filled pill. Answers what the bet IS in under a second.
A Bet standing yes The loudest element on the card. Segmented, five countable inputs, each named beside its segment.
A Segment track yes Five segments. Filled count is stated in figures beside it — no percent, no probability.
A Trust strip no Three icon + label + sub items across the footer: board depth, capture time, evidence tier.
A Ambient depth yes Team bloom top-right, state wash across the card, carbon and scanline texture.
B Support Score numeral yes 96px numeral in the same slot. Renders “––” until validated.
B Continuous track yes Replaces the five segments. Same geometry, same axis.
WHAT WE HAVE NOT EARNED YET
MODEL CONFIDENCE %No calibrated model today. Earning one is an explicit research goal.
COLD → HOT GAUGEPermanently out: heat frames the read as a stake size. The axis stays THIN to WELL-SUPPORTED.
RECOMMENDED PICKrecommendation is null with a raising constructor today. Ranked picks are on the roadmap, not in the payload.
“THOUSANDS OF SIMULATIONS”We do not run them today. Claiming it before we do would be the most dishonest thing on the page.
ITS BRANDING AND TYPEComposition and hierarchy only. Nothing of its identity.
ITS PHOTOGRAPHYOur subject is team identity as environment — colour and mark, never a photo.

WHY THIS SPOTLIGHT The spotlight always holds something checkable. When a finding survives it holds the finding; when none does — which is most nights — it holds where the price sits against the de-vigged consensus, because that is computable either way. It never holds nothing, and it never invents a judgement to fill itself. Today the system measures market state, not merit, so the spotlight is named for what it measures.
MOTION SPEC V2-32 → V2-34 · FEATURED BET
EYE FIRST The standing word — FLAGGED or NO DEMONSTRATED EDGE — at 56px, right-aligned. It is louder than the bet itself, because the read is the card’s job.
ANIMATES Card rises; spec strip at 120ms; segment track fills left to right 90ms apart; input rows stagger 40ms behind their segments; trust strip last.
TRIGGER On load or on submit. Flagged blooms once from the team edge; no_play does not bloom at all — confidence is stillness, and the calm state must not look like a weaker version of the loud one.
TIMING grise .72s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.3,1) · segment fill 90ms apart · row stagger 40ms · flagged bloom 420ms once · Tier B numeral would use price-arrival 340ms
HOVER / TAP Spec-strip cells hand off to the board. Segment rows hover white .035 and expose the raw field name. Spine label is decorative and not focusable.
SCROLL The card holds still. Only the team mark behind it parallaxes, at .04 — the numbers never move while being read.
MOBILE 390px: spine label becomes a top strip, spec strip stacks to two rows, standing word drops to 34px, and the five segment rows stay full width and in order.
22 TIER B · THE FLAGSHIP future, validation-dependent
Not a placeholder — the eventual centrepiece, designed now so that when the research earns a defensible result the only work left is binding real fields. Tier A and Tier B are the same object in two states, never two designs.
NOT YET EARNED The absence of a rating, a probability and a recommendation is a state, not a policy. The research programme exists to earn them — validated ratings, calibrated probabilities where scientifically defensible, ranked boards, props, totals, first five, sport-specific systems, large-scale backtesting, forward validation and public performance tracking. The design system should already know how to present that with enormous confidence the day it arrives.

WHY THE PROVENANCE STRIP IS PART OF THE PRIMITIVE
Every tout on the internet shows a big confident number with nothing behind it. The strip is what separates a 91 from a 91 — and it is inside the component, so a rating cannot be rendered anywhere in the product without it.
SAMPLEHow many settled bets the basis was built on. A rating from n = 40 is not a rating. FORWARD WINDOWOut-of-sample months. A backtest alone never unlocks Tier B. CALIBRATIONA measure against a naive baseline, so “calibrated” is a number rather than an adjective. LAST AUDITEDWhen it was recomputed. A stale rating is a stale claim. STRUCTURAL RULEThe strip has no empty state. If any of the four is missing, the component falls back to Tier A.

MOTION SPEC V2-35 · TIER B FLAGSHIP
EYE FIRST The rating numeral inside its ring, then the gap between our number and the market’s.
ANIMATES Ring sweeps 0 → its value in 900ms; numeral counts up with it; the gap bar grows from the market marker outward; provenance strip arrives last.
TRIGGER On load, once. The ring never re-sweeps on a poll that returned the same rating.
TIMING ring-sweep 900ms cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.3,1) · numeral count 900ms matched · gap grow 620ms · provenance 340ms after
HOVER / TAP Ring hover exposes the exact rating input breakdown. Provenance items hover to show their query. 56px targets.
SCROLL The card holds still; only the team mark parallaxes at .04.
MOBILE 390px: ring drops to 150px, the probability pair stacks with the gap between them as a full-width bar, provenance becomes two rows of two.
V2 · COMPLETE
CONFIDENT ANALYSIS.
CHECKABLE EVERY TIME.
Thirty-eight artboards across ten families, desktop and 390px, with their loading, empty, unavailable and error states. Every number binds to a named field in section 11 — including every segment of the bet standing. Tier A rates a bet from countable inputs only. Tier B — the validated rating, the probability gap, the ranked board — is designed as the flagship and blocked on validation, carrying its provenance inside the component so a number can never ship without what earned it.
GOVERNING RULES
Confidence is stillnessno_play holds calm; flagged earns the bloom
Red is reserveda genuinely better price, nothing else
Amber is not redcaution, pending, unavailable, paywall
Absence is a sentencenever a row of zeros
Every rate carries nor the constructor refuses it
Tier B carries its provenancea number never ships without its basis
